ignored.text: With Black Zenith, Stellarium turns toward the dark geometry of the cosmos, where distant suns dissolve, moons become unfamiliar worlds, and the boundaries of observation begin to blur. ignored.text: With Black Zenith, Stellarium turns toward the dark geometry of the cosmos, where distant suns dissolve, moons become unfamiliar worlds, and the boundaries of observation begin to blur.
